Focus only writes owner Focus records, never completes Tasks, awards/reverses points or posts Wallet. One shared AppJobs command per deadline/notice, no per-second persistent timer writes. Actual native HTTP job execution and registry pause/resume are tested. Browser reload/visibility wake is exercised; full process restart and physical OS suspend are not claimed by those cases.

P12 mute/quiet/daily preferences govern generic owner-only inbox notices. The existing I01/outbox adapter deduplicates per-session or owner/local-day digest without exposing Task titles or calling live providers.

Replacement snapshot pauses at validated capture time, credits only pre-capture elapsed and consumes historic pending notices, without auto-completion/counter/notification replay. Ordinary restart keeps durable deadlines.

Global vi/en/zh widget, Task drawer start, note/estimate, extra time, manual record, settings, paged100 history and audited corrections. Offline view is read-only; monotonic display adds elapsed since an already-live DTO exactly once; wake refreshes the native clock.
